seo.titulo: SONIA · Hand off the operational work and focus on what you do best
seo.descricao: Sônia coordinates up to 21 AI specialists: content, ads, WhatsApp customer service, finance, invoices, contracts and HR. You ask in Portuguese and get the work back finished.

hero.etiqueta: AI agents that deliver finished work
hero.titulo: Leave the operational work to Sônia
hero.titulo_destaque: and focus on what you do best.
hero.texto: Posting content, answering on WhatsApp, putting together a proposal, closing out the cash, reviewing a contract: up to 21 AI specialists take this on at any hour, through Telegram or the dashboard. Team size depends on the plan. What you do with the hours and the money left over is your call.

selos: Works at any hour, including nights and weekends
Each client gets their own agent, their own memory and their own data

agentes.cargo: Orchestrator · manager of the AI operation
agentes.resumo: Sônia is the manager of your artificial intelligence operation and the team's command center. She's the only one who talks to you directly: she takes the request in Portuguese, plans, breaks it into tasks, picks the right specialist, delegates, follows up, checks the result and only then delivers it to you finished. She works around the clock, doesn't sleep, doesn't run late and doesn't miss a day.

conselho.titulo: Facing a decision and not sure what to do?
conselho.texto: The team carries out what you ask. But what about before it goes to the team? Before you hire one more person, before you give that discount, or when you want a second opinion on a new venture, call Sônia and ask her to take it to the Council. She brings in the advisors who know the subject, pulls their views together and gives you back a single recommendation, showing where they disagree. If you approve, the team gets the tasks with deadlines.

Over a year, that's R$ 369.851. Starter costs R$ 4.997 per year, about R$ 416 per month, plus the AI subscription. The table shows the cost of each role done by people; the full team is on Magnata.

numeros.rotulo: years in sales and commercial roles

quem.texto:
I spent more than 30 years in sales and commercial roles before becoming a real estate broker in 2020. Nearly two decades of that were in telecom, at the major carriers, leading sales, channels and key accounts. After that came consulting for new companies and serving as head of sales and marketing.

I built Prime Circle for my own operation, and the AI agents ran first at my real estate agency: customer service, content, video and an internal council for the big decisions. What worked in practice is what I offer with Sônia. I set yours up with your processes in the onboarding session and, on Magnata, I follow the operation with you in the one-on-one mentoring sessions.

botao.texto: I want to be an agency

contato.titulo: Prefer to talk before you subscribe?
contato.texto: Leave your details. Our team will reach out on WhatsApp and show you Sônia in action.
contato.consentimento: I agree to be contacted by the Prime Circle team about this request, by email and WhatsApp, and to the use of my data for this purpose, under the Privacy Policy and the LGPD (Brazil's data protection law). I can request deletion at any time.
contato.mensagem_sucesso: Got it. The team will reach out to you on WhatsApp.
contato.nota: Your data is used only so our team can talk to you about this request. Nothing is sold.

itens.pergunta: Do I need to know how to code?
itens.resposta: No. You talk to Sônia in Portuguese, in the dashboard or on Telegram, and she coordinates the rest. Every screen in the dashboard has a step-by-step guide.

itens.pergunta: Is Sônia a fit for my type of business?
itens.resposta: The team covers the functions almost every business has: marketing, sales and customer service from Starter up, and finance, tax, legal and HR on Magnata. If you want to confirm your case, talk to the team before you subscribe.

itens.pergunta: Is one client's data kept separate from the others?
itens.resposta: Yes. Each client has their own agent, their own memory and their own password vault, isolated from the others.

itens.pergunta: Does it work with my WhatsApp?
itens.resposta: Yes, for serving your customers: the sales specialists answer on WhatsApp and in Instagram Direct. The WhatsApp connection uses the Evolution API, an unofficial system installed on a server of yours, and the customer service uses two artificial intelligence API keys, paid per use, separate from the ChatGPT subscription. Because it's not the official WhatsApp connection, there is a risk of the number being blocked. To give Sônia tasks, you use Telegram or the dashboard.

Plans are annual. You pay with each plan's button, by Pix in full or by card in up to 12 installments, and access arrives by email as soon as payment is confirmed. What changes between them is how many agents are unlocked, how many automated routines you can have and, on Magnata, the one-on-one mentoring with Prime Circle and the Executive Council. The AI subscription is purchased separately. All plans come with a 30-day guarantee.

It's four advisors, covering operations and team, marketing and sales, finance, and technology and data, for the decisions that affect your cash and your team. You tell Sônia about the decision, she brings together the ones who know the subject and gives you back a single recommendation. If you approve, the team gets the tasks. It's included in Magnata and costs R$ 1.997 per year as an add-on for Starter and Elite.

itens.pergunta: Does the Council replace my accountant or my lawyer?
itens.resposta: No. The Council helps you decide using your company's numbers and information. Taxes, payroll, contracts and data protection applied to your case stay with your accountant and your lawyer. When the matter is theirs, the Council tells you what to ask.

itens.pergunta: What's not included in the price?
itens.resposta: The AI subscription (on Starter, ChatGPT, from about US$ 20 per month; on Elite and Magnata, the model you choose), which you purchase and pay for directly with the provider. For WhatsApp customer service: hosting a server for the Evolution API and two artificial intelligence API keys, paid per use, separate from the ChatGPT subscription. For Instagram: Zernio, free up to 10 thousand messages per month. And any other tool you want to connect to the agents.

itens.pergunta: What if the AI goes down?
itens.resposta: Sônia depends on AI providers, such as ChatGPT, and on your subscription's quota. If a provider goes down or the quota runs out, she can't respond until the service comes back. That's why we don't promise operation without any interruption.
Yes. If within 30 days of payment you decide not to continue, we refund 100% of what you paid. Just ask by email at atendimento@primecircle.app.br or on WhatsApp.

itens.pergunta: How do I reach the team?
itens.resposta: Before subscribing, through the form on this page or by booking a demo. After subscribing, on WhatsApp (21) 99901-2520 or by email at atendimento@primecircle.app.br: our support agent answers at any hour, on every plan, and on Magnata there is also human support on business days, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.
